title: Whose Posts Get Ranked: Identical-Text Exposure Gaps in Bluesky Custom Feeds
abstract: arXiv:2608.13879v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bluesky lets users deploy custom feeds, independently operated recommendation algorithms that the platform serves alongside thousands of others. This paper investigates how evenly these feeds treat posts with the same text. To measure this, we take repeated snapshots of the Top-50 lists that 1,366 public feeds return, and we group posts with identical text, from different authors, that were created before the same list response and closely matched in age. Exposure diverges widely inside these matched sets, which span 250 feeds: in 33% of sets, one copy appears on the list while another does not. Fixed-effects regressions show that this divergence is associated with the author's history on the specific feed. Authors new to a feed receive less exposure for the same text (-0.061 in reciprocal-rank weight), while authors whose posts the feed has returned before receive more. translated_title: 谁的帖子被排名：Bluesky自定义信息流中的相同文本曝光差距
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13879v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：Bluesky允许用户部署自定义信息流，这些是独立运营的推荐算法，平台与数千个其他信息流一同提供。本文调查了这些信息流如何均匀地处理具有相同文本的帖子。为了衡量这一点，我们对1,366个公共信息流返回的前50名列表进行了重复快照，并将来自不同作者、在同一列表响应之前创建且年龄相近的具有相同文本的帖子分组。在这些匹配集中，曝光差异很大，涵盖了250个信息流：在33%的集合中，一个副本出现在列表中，而另一个则没有。固定效应回归显示，这种差异与作者在该特定信息流上的历史记录相关。新加入信息流的作者对相同文本获得的曝光较少（倒数排名权重为-0.061），而之前帖子已被该信息流返回的作者获得更多曝光。即使新作者拥有比竞争对手更多的关注者，情况依然如此。
tldr: 本文揭示了Bluesky自定义信息流中，相同文本的帖子因作者历史记录不同而存在显著的曝光差距，即使新作者拥有更多关注者，其曝光仍较低。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals significant exposure gaps for identical-text posts in Bluesky custom feeds due to author history, where new authors receive less exposure even with more followers.
